name: Lily pad
style: low-poly, flat colours, a round notched pad with a cupped pink water-lily bloom (Quaternius 2019)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: The plan's source (a Quaternius static lily pad on poly.pizza) is behind a Cloudflare challenge; this is Lilypad.fbx from Quaternius's Ultimate Nature Pack on OpenGameArt (License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0), the same zip and pin as the tree, tree-palm, tree-pine, tree-autumn, bush and flowers entries, so they read as one set. It is a round pad with the classic notch and a cupped water-lily bloom (two rings of pointed petals) in the middle; the pack's only lily pad. Size normalised on the pad's diameter, not the height: the source is 1.20 x 0.22 x 1.20 m (pad diameter x bloom top x diameter), scaled so the pad is 0.50 m across (a water lily or lotus pad in a garden or shrine pond is 0.2-0.6 m; 0.5 m is a full-grown one), which puts the top of the bloom at 0.092 m, so height and ingest.height are 0.092. The pad itself is about 1 cm thick. Colours on noon (no green), as the other plants: pad vermilion (accent) shading to iris, the foliage colour of the set, which stands out against a pale or dark water surface; the pink bloom is cream (moon) shading to pale skin pink, so it reads as a pink-white lily and stays apart from the pad. The petals are closed shells (a doubleSided render was identical), so nothing is double-sided. Its lowest point sits on y = 0; a film places it at the water line. Static: no clips.
